elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting the other party’s personnel.
elements.evidence: The operative clause binds “Neither party,” so Customer remains prohibited from soliciting covered personnel without consent.

elements.element: The non-solicitation restriction applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause applies to “Neither party,” and the added carve-outs likewise apply to “either party.”

elements.element: The restriction is limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The restriction covers only personnel “who have had direct involvement with the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months from the end of each covered person’s involvement in the Services.
elements.evidence: The clause runs throughout the Agreement term and for one year after Agreement termination, rather than for 12 months from the end of the individual person’s involvement. It can therefore continue more than 12 months after that involvement ends.

elements.element: General advertisements and other general solicitations not specifically directed at the other party’s personnel are excluded.
elements.evidence: Subsection (a) excludes general solicitations, including general advertisements, job postings, and untargeted recruiting-firm searches.

elements.element: Approaches initiated by personnel without solicitation are excluded.
elements.evidence: Subsection (b) permits employing or engaging anyone who approaches a party on their own initiative without solicitation.

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring or engagement itself as distinct from solicitation.
elements.evidence: The primary prohibition is only against “solicit[ing] for hire”; it does not separately prohibit hiring, and subsection (b) expressly permits employment or engagement following general solicitations or unsolicited approaches.

result.reason: The redline adds the required mutual carve-outs and does not create a no-hire, but it leaves Customer subject to the non-solicit and retains a term measured from Agreement termination rather than from each person’s end of involvement. It therefore reaches neither the preferred nor the complete fallback position. The additions are otherwise coherent and do not disturb unrelated terms, but the failure to revise the duration trigger is a material drafting omission.
